import Tag from '../Tag'
import { Card, Descricao, Titulo, Infos, Imagem, Informacoes } from './styles'

type Props = {
  title: string
  category: string
  system: string
  description: string
  infos: string[]
  image: string
}

const Product = ({ description, image, infos, title }: Props) => (
  <Card>
    <Informacoes>
      <Imagem src={image} alt={title} />
      <Infos>
      {infos.map((info) => (
        <Tag key={info}>{info}</Tag>
      ))}
      </Infos>
      <Titulo>{title}</Titulo>
      <Descricao>{description}</Descricao>
      </Informacoes>
  </Card>
)

export default Product
